items.text:
CHANGED FROM NEGATIVE TO POSITIVE BELOW

I want to like this. I do. but my God. I get wanting to simulate a difficult life, that's what I WANTED. Fighting the environment is cool, fighting enemies? Dope. Fighting the controls and UI? That's like a Souls game that needs a button combo to roll. I should be punished for bad decision making - not due to how fast I can read a wiki-how. Add a tutorial where you learn to fly a ship and THEN stick me in a Space Toyota Corolla and I'd be okay with it because I had a chance to learn. If I wasn't paying attention while my hand was being held that's on me. Soft locking me in the first 5 minutes twice because I wasn't told what to do in time is insufferable. No, a text box I have to open in a separate menu while moving like a piss-missile and expected to do 10 things I've never done before is NOT a substitute. All that brought me right to the refund page. 

Look if you are a masochist and want to pull your hair out to learn, go hog wild man. If you're like me and expected a challenge that was fair but punishing, I'd sit this one out for a bit. And believe you me, I saw the same comments you are seeing and thought "Meh, can't be that bad" it is, man. Devs, you guys are onto something here, just please think about adding a chance to learn the game. Ivy Tech doesn't have a class for this and I don't feel like edging an stroke to go through the first docking section 100x. I'll keep an eye on this and if something comes along I'll consider rebuying but until then, to the shelf it goes.

EDIT: After a few year, I gave this another shot and I'm blown away. There's a decent tutorial, things are explained to you, albeit pretty basically, but with how much you can do with the mechanics I think it's serviceable. Though I didn't see it until now, the devs reached out with genuine intent to hear what my issues were and even if I didn't get the chance to reply, I feel like they took it into account with the few updates. this is now one of my new addictions, and if you don't mind a steep learning curve and typical early access issues, I can't recommend it enough
items.text_zh:
以下内容从负面变为正面

我想喜欢这个。我真的想。但我的天啊。我理解想要模拟艰难的生活，那正是我想要的。与环境抗争很酷，与敌人战斗？太棒了。与操作和界面抗争？那就像是一个需要按键组合才能翻滚的魂类游戏。我应该因为糟糕的决策而受到惩罚——而不是因为我读wiki-how的速度有多快。加一个教程，让你学会驾驶飞船，然后把我塞进一辆太空丰田卡罗拉，我会接受的，因为我有机会学习。如果在我被手把手教的时候我没注意，那是我的问题。在头5分钟里因为没人及时告诉我该做什么而两次把我软锁，这让人无法忍受。不，一个我必须在移动中像尿导弹一样打开单独菜单里的文本框，还指望我做10件我从未做过的事，这不是替代品。所有这些直接把我带到了退款页面。

听着，如果你是个受虐狂，想揪着头发学习，那就尽情去吧，老兄。如果你像我一样，期待一个公平但严苛的挑战，我会暂时不碰这个。相信我，我看到了你看到的那些同样的评论，心想“嗯，不可能那么糟”，它就是那么糟，老兄。开发者们，你们在这里有点东西，只是请考虑加一个学习游戏的机会。Ivy Tech没有这门课，我也不想为了通过第一个对接部分100次而边缘到中风。我会继续关注这个，如果有进展我会考虑重新购买，但在此之前，它就上架吃灰吧。

编辑：几年后，我又试了一次，我被震撼了。有一个像样的教程，事情会向你解释，虽然相当基础，但考虑到你能用这些机制做多少事，我觉得它够用了。虽然我直到现在才看到，但开发者们带着真诚的意图联系我，想听听我的问题是什么，即使我没机会回复，我觉得他们在几次更新中考虑到了这一点。这现在成了我的新瘾之一，如果你不介意陡峭的学习曲线和典型的抢先体验问题，我强烈推荐它
